bills.title: Combatting Antisemitism, Hate and Extremism (Firearms and Customs Laws) Bill 2026

name: The majority voted against an amendment to the motion that the report from the committee be adopted. This means the amendment failed. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add "and the provisions of the bill be referred to the Legal and Constitutional Affairs Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 2 March 2026".*
